name: Arya Rhodes
tagline: Top rated Employment Litigation attorney in Sherman Oaks, California

about: Arya Rhodes is a zealous trial litigator with over a decade of legal experience. From the law firm Schimmel & Parks, APLC, in Sherman Oaks, California, he represents clients in a diverse range of matters concerning:

With an unwavering commitment to justice and a deep understanding of employment law, Mr. Rhodes champions the rights of whistleblowers who courageously expose misconduct in their workplaces. His advocacy extends to victims of sex abuse and workplace discrimination, offering them a compassionate and steadfast legal ally in their pursuit of accountability and justice.

A 2008 B.A. graduate of San Diego State University, Mr. Rhodes enrolled at the Southwestern Law School in Los Angeles, California, to pursue his legal education. In 2014, he received his Juris Doctor with magna cum laude honors. He is licensed to practice in California as well as before the U.S. District Court for the Central and Southern Districts of California.

A highly accomplished professional, Mr. Rhodes has secured millions of dollars in compensation on behalf of his clients, including some record-setting verdicts in the state and federal courts of California. As a result, he has been honored in several ways by prestigious legal organizations. He has been included in the list of the Consumer Attorneys Association of Los Angeles (CAALA) – Rising Stars and the National Trial Lawyers: Top 100. Additionally, he is a fellow of the American Board of Trial Advocates.
